  stage <- coalesce(as.numeric(school_stage), as.numeric(school_stage_2010) + 1)
  grade <- as.numeric(school_grade)
  year <- case_when(
    stage == 3 & grade %in% 1:6 ~ grade,
    stage == 4 & grade %in% 1:3 ~ grade + 6,
    stage == 5 & grade %in% 1:3 ~ grade + 9,
    .default = NA_real_
  )
  if_else(is.na(year), NA_character_, paste0("Grade ", year))
})
